decisions.question: the flipped in-hand pre-place has no IK at any trunk — how does the first demo get its flipped blocks?
decisions.context: Probe: picks pass at every pitch class; every remaining failure is the pre-place exact IK of the flipped in-hand orientation (carried-tilt flip). Prepared switch generation.block_no_flip (5e30334).
options: A) goal face up at init (generation.block_no_flip: true — no flip, yaw-align stays)
B) flip on the table (place in the intermediate orientation, re-grasp, place — new sub-chain, sampler + oracle)
decisions.default: A for the first demo, B as the required end state (prep workstream)
decisions.answer: A now + B required end state (prep workstream, one pod, not blocking the first-demo pass): block_no_flip on block_4-breakfast_table, first-demo loop running; the sampler records a table-flip sub-chain (place intermediate → re-grasp → place), the oracle emits grasp → place → grasp → place, QA one FOV span per grasp→release

decisions.question: the A1 brace gate rejects 902/1694 partner cells (right / left bands do not overlap) — brace optional, or keep it?
decisions.context: Attempts 30–100 s after the batched screening (094cfe3); no instance yet; the joint two-arm placement (work point in the right band AND brace point in the left contact band at one trunk) has no cell for lid/teapot.
options: A) brace optional for attachment (as axial / block design)
B) partner only in the band overlap (yield drops to the overlap)
C) keep the brace: record a second base pose after the male grasp from which the left brace and the mating pose are reachable (sidecar transition, oracle executes it holding the object)
decisions.answer: C — the brace stays: second base pose (lateral trunk move + torso adjust) recorded after the grasp as a sidecar transition; the oracle executes the recorded move while holding the object, no runtime stance re-planning; brace optional only if the joint placement has no cell after that (tabletop → oracle; core if a new action type is needed)

decisions.question: hinged_jar's best focus is 24° off the optical axis vs the 20° Phase-2 cone — relax to 25° for small articulation?
decisions.context: Phase 2 finds 0 (stance, focus) pairs within the 20° loose class for the hinged jar (rigid head camera, no independent tilt); 25° admits 42 foci over 3 stand-offs. Toolbox = yield (no_workspace), laptop target_placement.

decisions.answer: A — 25° / focus-in-frame for open + close (tabletop implementing, then the hinged_jar loop; spec §6.7)
